_comment: P3-3 LangChain4j bodies EN（2026-11-03）。sections 与源侧固定小节对齐；sources 按索引对齐 frontmatter。

axes.model_access: A unified Java interface over multiple LLMs and vector stores; the official docs list major commercial and open-source models. The current supported list follows official docs and is not enumerated here.
axes.runtime: Runs inside your JVM application; the official docs offer Quarkus, Spring Boot and Helidon integrations so LLM calls sit inside existing Java services.
axes.local_files: Files and vector stores are managed by the application; the framework hosts no data itself.
axes.background: A library with no built-in task queue; long-running work uses the application's own threads or message queue.
axes.tools: Supports tool calling (letting the LLM call Java methods) and MCP integration; details follow official docs.
axes.context: Conversation memory and context are configured by the application; the framework offers memory abstractions while persistence is yours to attach.
axes.permissions: Runs in-process on the JVM; permissions come from the application and deployment environment, with no built-in multi-tenant isolation.
axes.fit: Fits Java/Kotlin teams with existing Spring/Quarkus services who want LLMs and vector retrieval inside business code. Does not fit Python/TS teams, turnkey agents, or visual orchestration.

runs: This site has not completed integration or performance tests; the conclusions cover the API and capabilities disclosed in official docs only.
